resolution.question: Does the Springfield City Council vote to approve the 2027 budget during the October 5, 2026 meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Springfield City Council voted to approve the 2027 budget during the meeting that started on 2026-10-05T18:00:00-05:00 and before 2026-10-05T23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
